```{python}
#| echo: false

import os
import json

from scrips.heatmap import gtfs_heatmap_grid_crs

# =========================================================
# Folders
# =========================================================
folder_gtfs = "Data/GTFS"
folder_animation = "Data/GTFS_animation"

os.makedirs(folder_animation, exist_ok=True)

# =========================================================
# Detectar archivos GTFS
# =========================================================
files = sorted([
    f for f in os.listdir(folder_gtfs)
    if f.endswith(".json")
])

# =========================================================
# Crear index.json
# =========================================================
with open(
    os.path.join(folder_animation, "index.json"),
    "w",
    encoding="utf-8"
) as f:

    json.dump(
        files,
        f,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        indent=2
    )

# =========================================================
# Procesar cada GTFS
# =========================================================
for file_name in files:
    gtfs_path = os.path.join(folder_gtfs, file_name)

    # ---------------------------------------------
    # Cargar JSON GTFS
    # ---------------------------------------------
    with open(gtfs_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        raw = json.load(f)

    data_gtfs = raw["Data"]

    # ---------------------------------------------
    # Generar heatmap animable
    # ---------------------------------------------
    heat_dump = gtfs_heatmap_grid_crs(
        data_gtfs,
        interval=15,
        grid_m=100,
        first=True,
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------
    # Nombre salida
    # ---------------------------------------------
    base_name = os.path.splitext(file_name)[0]

    output_path = os.path.join(
        folder_animation,
        f"{base_name}_animation.json"
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------
    # Guardar
    # ---------------------------------------------
    with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(
            heat_dump,
            f,
            ensure_ascii=False
        )
```
